headline: Week 1: QAmon Catches a Body, Browning Out Benches a 47-Burger
subhead: The 2025 Delt Dynasty season opened with one team scoring 91, another leaving Justin Fields on the pine, and Daniel Jones — yes, that one — outscoring half the league.
matchOfTheWeek: Egbukkake hanging 152 on QAmon while Kyle's lineup wheezed out a 91 isn't a 'matchup' — it's a hostage situation. Szara traded for Drake Maye, Hunter Henry, Keenan Allen AND Kyren Williams in the offseason, then dropped 61 points on the guy who literally calls Spencer Rattler 'dead rat.' Maybe stop nicknaming everyone and start a real QB, Kyle.
powerRankingsShakeup: McBridesStrangeWhiteHock vaults to the top after a 168-point haymaker fueled by — checks notes — Daniel Jones. QAmon and Stroud Boys are already drafting their excuse columns.
mainRecap:
Let's start with Browning Out, who somehow scored 132 points and STILL deserves to be roasted. Patrick left 47 points on his bench, headlined by Justin Fields dropping a 29.52 in street clothes while Reegs trotted out somebody else to lose by 27 to Nut Olave Your Face. That's not a lineup, that's a cry for help. Zay Flowers went for 28 and it didn't matter because management was asleep at the wheel.

Nick over at Nut Olave Your Face won, sure, but let's not pretend 'Nail polish enthusiast' going for 24 and Mustard chipping in 24 more is some galaxy-brain move — he made roughly 47 trades this offseason and still left Big Penix (24) and Quentin Johnston (24.90) rotting on the bench. You traded FOR Q.J. and benched him. Be serious.

The Good Ladds dropped 167 because 3rd Overall Somehow decided to remind everyone he's actually 1st overall this week with a 38.76. Mig also left Keon Coleman's 25.20 on the bench, which is a Good Ladds problem to have. Stroud Boys, meanwhile, got cooked by 41 and benched a 25-burger from Aaron Rodgers — bjewett spent the offseason trading away Kyren Williams for Russell Wilson and starting Davis Mills-tier QBs. Money Mill$ ain't walking through that door, chief.

T swift's Baddies got Lamar's 29 and still lost by 38, which means literally everyone else on that roster ghosted. Little Peckers got 26 from Mahomes and still couldn't crack 102 against Christian McCalfinjury, who rode Derrick Henry's 29.20 to a comfy W. Rub My Chubb lost the 'closest' game, which is the participation ribbon of fantasy. And QAmon? ShAmon-Ra apparently took the week off with the rest of the roster. 91 points. In SuperFlex. Pour one out for King Unc.

weeklyAwards.blurb: Left 47 points on the pine including a 29-piece from Justin Fields — congrats on winning the loser's bracket of your own roster.

weeklyAwards.blurb: Made 38 trades, dropped 152 on Kyle, and still found time to nickname his backup tight end — touch grass, Szara.

weeklyAwards.blurb: Highest score of the week powered by Danny Dimes and Josh Jacobs — the universe is broken and Rocks is cashing in.
